headline: General Dynamics (GD) Lands $1.3 Billion Cybersecurity Contract With A Key Defense Customer
summary: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) unit GDIT has been awarded a US$1.3b multi year contract to provide network operations and cybersecurity support for the Army National Guard. The award expands GDIT's role in defense IT and cybersecurity services for a key federal customer. The contract highlights growing demand for advanced technologies and AI capabilities in US national defense infrastructure.
